channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 25
item.description:
64 development commits

Combat & Weapon Balance

  • Radwater now deals significant damage to full kits with damage scaling based on reduced rad amounts, the semi‑automatic pistol gains stronger damage falloff at range and its high‑quality metal crafting cost increased to 6, and weapon body spawn rates were tweaked – SMG bodies slightly up, Rifle bodies slightly down.
  • Flashlight toggles with right‑click like a torch, includes new animations, tooltip update, and automatically extinguishes when the player sleeps or disconnects.
  • Helicopter armor colliders for both HAB and attack helicopters are now correctly set up for client and server removal with unique collider group names.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Store UI now supports DynamicFullscreenSprite and DynamicGallerySprite fields, includes a DynamicPagePrefab for the shadow page, default picker rendering, and shows integrated sale information (item prices and potential earnings) with layout fixes.
  • Session modal overflow fixed – description scroll works and long texts no longer block the disconnect button.
  • Bear rug and regular rug comfort radii increased: 100 % comfort within 2 m (bear) or 1 m (rug) with gradual falloff to 3 m/2 m respectively.

Animals & Livestock

  • Rabbit assets added and renamed for consistency, and new SellAnimals and AnimalSalePreview panels let players view nearby sellable animals and preview rewards.

Vehicles & Handling

  • Modular car handling improved: reduced body roll, prevented spin‑outs, and smoother steering at high speeds.

AI, World & Events

  • Low‑resolution navmesh on ghost ships fixed and old AI no longer flees when the player jumps.
  • Cargo ship event now preserves crate positions and loot round progress across server restarts; spawn points are de‑duplicated.
  • Launch siren off‑state visibility corrected.
  • Terrain hole depth assignment fixed in pre‑pass rendering.

Health & Alerts

  • Health Threshold toggle added, allowing players to set custom health warning levels in the HUD.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 24
item.description:
68 development commits

Animals

  • Fixed frog animation glitches, corrected sideways skating and movement speed, and added a new water‑seeking 'interested' state where frogs croak and move toward shallow water.
  • Added a drinking water need for livestock, allowing them to hydrate from containers or natural water sources.
  • Enabled Stable B for animal trading, introducing basic NPC conversation and selling mechanics for animals.

Vehicles

  • Added restoreHierarchy flag to pooled vehicles, fixing UI pooling issues for vehicle objects.
  • Improved car handling: fixed handbrake logic, prevented duck toggle lock, applied raw tyre force, refined suspension, steering, grip, and added visual rear‑wheel lock during handbrake.
  • Introduced a configurable setting to adjust the drone detonation distance and updated helicopter passenger seat weapons to apply aim sway scaled by movement speed.

UI & Inventory

  • Various UI stability and visual fixes: health bar now shows when hitting monument blockers, store prop drawer fallback image added, FadeCanvasGroup null‑reference crash prevented, arrow revamp icons corrected, and homing launcher UI now displays 'Keep on target' with lock‑on timer reduced by 30%.
  • Hotbar now allows swapping of overstacks via server‑side RPC, repair bench functionality fixed, and random skin crafting now includes the default skin as a possible outcome.

Gameplay & Balance

  • SAM sites receive new anti‑drone buffs: proximity‑fuse missiles, 2.25× speed lead without aim error, and ability to destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 23
item.description:
20 development commits

Monuments & World

  • Fixed missing navmesh on Ghost Ship A, restoring proper AI navigation.

Items & Inventory

  • Reduced beancan stack size from 5 to 4.

Equipment

  • Heavy plate helmet now muffles game audio when equipped.

Fuel & Dome

  • Capped dome fuel pump crude storage to 1000 per pump.
